correctness.rationale: Direct differentiation of relative phase field at splay gives exact linear -9δ I and Q(x,y)=sqrt3/4(x²+2xy-2y²,2x²-2xy-y²). The quotient metric r²=2(x²-xy+y²)/3 satisfies ||Q(w)||_q²=27r^4/32; independent symbolic expansion confirms this identity. The radial bound d(r²/2)/dt <=(-9δ+(3sqrt6/8)r+C(r²+δr))r² proves an invariant, strictly inward ball of radius 4sqrt6 δ-O(δ²), with all its points converging. Blowing up w=δW produces -9W+Q(W); independently verified precisely the three specified nonzero simple roots with quotient radius sqrt96=4sqrt6 and Jacobian eigenvalues 9,-27. IFT yields nearby saddle equilibria outside the basin, limiting its centered ball by the same leading distance. Local error bounds constrain every nonzero small equilibrium to O(δ) and ensure no omitted roots. Both chiralities follow by relabelling; synchrony eigenvalues remain negative.

final_claim: For identical pairwise three-phase oscillators with H_a(t)=sin t+a sin3t, δ=a-1/6>0, both splay attractors have centered quotient-Euclidean basin-ball inradius 4sqrt6 δ+O(δ²); three simple saddle branches at the same asymptotic radius realize the sharp obstruction while synchrony remains stable.
limitations: Only sufficiently small δ>0 in the specified identical pairwise phase model, not stochastic/noisy or delay-differential dynamics.
